marketMood: Risk-on recovery: Nasdaq climbs 1.3% and chip stocks rebound into Alphabet/Tesla earnings tonight, with oil near $90 on US-Iran tensions and Fed hawks shadowing the July 28-29 FOMC meeting.

upcomingEvents.event: Alphabet (GOOGL) & Tesla (TSLA) Q2 earnings after bell
AMD Advancing AI 2026 event — Zen 6 CPU launch (Day 1)
FOMC rate decision — ~25% probability of 25bp rate hike

topStories.headline: Alphabet and Tesla Q2 Earnings Tonight Put AI Capex Narrative to the Test
topStories.summary: Alphabet and Tesla report Q2 2026 results after the bell, with expectations of 20%+ revenue growth for Alphabet's cloud and record delivery-driven profits for Tesla, marking the first real reckoning of whether AI spending generates tangible returns.
topStories.marketImpact: GOOGL and TSLA could surge ↑ on strong AI cloud and EV results; a capex-heavy miss risks a repeat of last week's Mag-7 selloff; INTC reports Thursday

topStories.headline: Chip Stocks and Nasdaq Stage 5%+ Rebound After Last Week's AI-Driven Selloff
topStories.summary: US indices rose Tuesday — S&P 500 +0.89%, Nasdaq +1.29%, Dow +0.74% — with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surging over 5% as markets stabilised following last week's sharp AI-driven rout.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA, AMD ↑; broader chip sector recovery fragile heading into tonight's Alphabet and Tesla earnings

topStories.headline: Fed's Waller Flags Hawkish Tilt Ahead of July 28-29 FOMC Meeting
topStories.summary: Governor Waller said the Fed's focus has 'completely flipped' to inflation containment, raising CME FedWatch odds of a 25bp hike at next week's meeting to ~25%; rates currently hold at 3.50-3.75%.
topStories.marketImpact: Rate-sensitive sectors ↓; USD ↑; TLT and long-duration bonds volatile; equity risk premium widening

topStories.headline: US-Iran Conflict Drives Brent Above $90 as Strait of Hormuz Flows Collapse 62%
topStories.summary: Ongoing US strikes on Iranian coastal and military targets have cut confirmed crude flows through the Strait of Hormuz to 4.1 million barrels per day, down 62% from normal; a 60-day ceasefire memorandum expires August 16.
topStories.marketImpact: Energy stocks ↑ (XLE, CVX, COP); airline and shipping costs ↑; oil-driven inflation adds upward pressure on the Fed's rate path

topStories.headline: Andy Burnham Becomes UK's Seventh Prime Minister in a Decade
topStories.summary: Andy Burnham was appointed UK Prime Minister on July 20, replacing Keir Starmer who resigned following election defeats and scandals; Trump immediately called Britain a 'Poverty Stricken Disaster.'
topStories.marketImpact: GBP volatile ↓ on political instability; FTSE 100 under mild pressure; UK gilts and EWU in focus

topStories.headline: Hang Seng Falls 1.8% as HK Stocks' Discount to China Widens on Liquidity Pressure
topStories.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng slid 446 points as tighter capital outflow controls and persistent liquidity pressures expanded the valuation gap between HK-listed shares and their mainland Chinese counterparts.
topStories.marketImpact: 0700.HK (Tencent), 9988.HK (Alibaba), 3690.HK (Meituan) pressured ↓; structural discount likely to persist near term

topStories.headline: Apple Intelligence Wins Chinese Regulatory Approval, Runs on Alibaba's Qwen
topStories.summary: China's Cyberspace Administration cleared Apple Intelligence with Alibaba's Qwen as the primary foundation model for iOS/macOS in China, opening AI features to over a billion iPhones ahead of Apple's fall software cycle.
topStories.marketImpact: AAPL ↑ on China AI growth unlock; 9988.HK (Alibaba) ↑ as exclusive primary AI partner; 9888.HK (Baidu) secondary beneficiary

topStories.headline: BOJ Holds at 1% (30-Year High); Nikkei Surges 3.26% on Semiconductor Rebound
topStories.summary: With the Bank of Japan at its highest rate since 1995, the Nikkei 225 closed at 66,232 (+3.26%) on Tuesday as semiconductor stocks recovered globally; UBS maintained an 'Attractive' view on Japanese equities after the recent pullback.
topStories.marketImpact: Japanese tech exporters ↑; yen strengthening creates headwind for Toyota (7203.T) and Sony (6758.T); carry trade unwind risk remains elevated

topStories.headline: South Korea's KOSPI Bounces 4.7% After Monday's AI Chip-Led 4.5% Crash
topStories.summary: The KOSPI fell 4.5% Monday — pushing the index more than 22% below its monthly peak and into bear-market territory — before recovering 4.7% Tuesday as Samsung and SK Hynix stabilised on improving global AI chip sentiment.
topStories.marketImpact: 005930.KS (Samsung), 000660.KS (SK Hynix) bouncing ↑ after heavy losses; KOSPI remains deep in bear-market territory for the month

topStories.headline: AMD Kicks Off 'Advancing AI 2026' Event with Zen 6 CPU Launch
topStories.summary: AMD's two-day Advancing AI 2026 event begins today featuring the Zen 6 Venice CPU launch, a critical catalyst as AMD shares sit 17% below their June peak amid sector-wide AI sentiment pressure.
topStories.marketImpact: AMD ↑ on positive product reception; potential to shift competitive narrative vs. NVDA and INTC; broader chip sector sentiment watch

tickerDescriptions.GOOGL: Alphabet Inc., Google's parent company and global leader in search, advertising, cloud computing, and AI
tickerDescriptions.TSLA: Tesla Inc., electric vehicle and clean energy company known for EVs, energy storage, and autonomous driving
tickerDescriptions.INTC: Intel Corporation, US chipmaker producing CPUs and competing in the AI accelerator market
tickerDescriptions.NVDA: NVIDIA Corporation, dominant AI GPU and data center chip maker with ~70-80% market share in AI training workloads
tickerDescriptions.AMD: Advanced Micro Devices, semiconductor company making CPUs and GPUs and competing with NVIDIA in AI infrastructure
tickerDescriptions.SMH: VanEck Semiconductor ETF tracking the performance of the world's largest semiconductor companies
tickerDescriptions.TLT: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF, a proxy for long-duration US government bond performance
tickerDescriptions.XLE: Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF tracking major US energy companies including ExxonMobil and Chevron
tickerDescriptions.CVX: Chevron Corporation, one of the world's largest integrated oil and gas companies
tickerDescriptions.COP: ConocoPhillips, US-based upstream oil and gas exploration and production company
tickerDescriptions.EWU: iShares MSCI United Kingdom ETF, tracking the performance of UK large- and mid-cap equities
tickerDescriptions.0700.HK: Tencent Holdings Ltd, China's largest social media, gaming, payments, and AI conglomerate listed in Hong Kong
tickerDescriptions.9988.HK: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd, China's leading e-commerce and cloud computing platform listed in Hong Kong
tickerDescriptions.3690.HK: Meituan, China's dominant food delivery, hotel booking, and local commerce super-app
tickerDescriptions.AAPL: Apple Inc., maker of iPhone, Mac, and iPad and operator of the iOS App Store ecosystem
tickerDescriptions.9888.HK: Baidu Inc., China's largest search engine and a leading AI research and autonomous driving company
tickerDescriptions.7203.T: Toyota Motor Corporation, Japan's largest automaker and global leader in hybrid and hydrogen vehicles
tickerDescriptions.6758.T: Sony Group Corporation, Japan's diversified consumer electronics, entertainment, and gaming conglomerate
tickerDescriptions.9984.T: SoftBank Group Corp., Japan's technology investment conglomerate and major backer of AI and internet companies
tickerDescriptions.005930.KS: Samsung Electronics Co. Ltd, South Korea's largest company and a global leader in memory chips and consumer electronics
tickerDescriptions.000660.KS: SK Hynix Inc., South Korea's second-largest chipmaker and a major global supplier of DRAM and NAND flash memory

Danaher shares plunged after trimming its earnings forecast; GM and Philip Morris also reporting this week in a busy calendar (Yahoo Finance)
